item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We’re working to prevent that future—and to secure a ban on superintelligence before it’s too late.

2. We believe the stakes are stark: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and a catastrophe killing at least a billion people will follow. We’re working toward a ban because no one should take that risk with humanity.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We work on communications and policy toward a ban on superintelligence. Preventing this catastrophe must come first.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We face a clear choice about the future of artificial intelligence. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We hold this position with full conviction, and we believe preventing that outcome must be a priority for everyone shaping AI policy. At the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, we work on communications and policy toward a ban on superintelligence. This is not a problem we can afford to treat as an abstract debate or a distant possibility. The decisions made now will shape whether this technology is ever built—and whether humanity has a future beyond it.
